annotation.evidence_span: MUST continue to have the VERSION flag set
annotation.interpretation_a: The VERSION flag should remain set on all packets even after a version has been negotiated, indicating that version negotiation *has* occurred.
annotation.interpretation_b: The VERSION flag should remain set on all packets until the new version is fully adopted, and then can be cleared.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'continue to have' is open to interpretation. Does it mean 'always', or 'for a period of time'? The lack of a time constraint creates ambiguity about when the VERSION flag can be unset.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the VERSION flag is intended to be permanently set after negotiation, or only for a limited duration. A clear statement about when the VERSION flag can be cleared would resolve the ambiguity.
